blurb: Boardwalk Marina offers over 1,000 feet of riverfront dockage and 165 floating slips on the Housatonic River. It provides full-service boat repair including engine, fiberglass, electronics, air conditioning, and sanitation systems. The marina also features onsite dining at Joey C's waterfront restaurant and is located near a train station and shopping.
